# AdSquirrel

AdSquirrel is a digital marketing agency operated by Nexston Corporations Pvt Ltd.

## Business
- Office: 1st Floor, Kinfra Hi-Tech Park, Kalamassery, Kerala – 683503, India.
- Service area: Kerala. Location pages represent service areas, not additional offices.
- Email: support@nexston.in
- Telephone: +91 9846730362

## Services
- Search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO)
- Google Ads and Meta Ads / performance marketing
- Social media strategy and content
- Brand strategy and design
- Website design and development
- Video and creative production

## Accuracy
No particular ranking, AI citation or business outcome is guaranteed. Illustrative creative work is labeled as a concept. The website does not present fabricated client reviews as genuine testimonials. This file is descriptive and does not provide special inclusion in an AI engine.
